entities.summary: Haason Samir Reddick is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Temple Owls, and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the first round of the 2017 NFL draft. He also played for the Carolina Panthers, Philadelphia Eagles, New York Jets, and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
